findings.detail: Generated identifiers are carrying maturity dates that disagree with the current-year Schedule of Investments maturity cells; several structured maturity_date values match the raw source instead.
Databricks current-year source maturity is 1/3/2031, while the generated identifier says 1/3/2032 and the structured twin in the bundle says 2032-01-05.

rationale: Class 2 row-level adjudication. The raw Schedule of Investments source is available and decides the issue. For multiple flagged rows, the filing maturity cell contradicts the date embedded in bdc_investment_identifier; examples include AMCP Clean 6/15/2030 vs identifier 6/15/2028, USA DeBusk 4/30/2031 vs identifier 4/30/2030, Pluto Holdco 6/5/2026 vs identifier 12/9/2025, DRS Holdings III 11/1/2028 vs identifier 5/31/2030, and Service Express revolver 12/23/2032 vs identifier 8/15/2031. This is a real generated-data defect, localized to the row identifier/maturity extraction path, not a false alarm.
